title: Panel commands not working consistently on Wear OS on Galaxy Watch 6 classic
symptom: Tile commands on Wear OS do not work consistently when not using an AAPS supplied watchface. They work for a while inconsistently and then eventually no longer get a response from the phone app. Force closing and restarting the app on the watch resumes function for a period of time before it quits working again.
cause: Android OS kills apps in the background, and there is currently no solution.
evidence_quote: yes, android kills apps on background. Currently there is no solution
